items.rationale: Only rows 2 and 4 are Nairobi, so SUMIFS adds 100 + 50 = 150 and ignores the Mombasa row.
The weeks at or above 100 are 120, 100 and 130. The 100 counts because >= includes the boundary, so the answer is 3.

A looked-up target stays linked to the target table, so a corrected target flows through to achievement and rating automatically. Typed numbers are allowed in Excel but go out of date, and XLOOKUP neither rounds nor sorts.
AND needs both conditions, and 2 good weeks is below 3, so the first test is FALSE. The next test, 102 >= 90, is TRUE, so the rating is Watch.
